verdict.rationale: Gmail's documented REST API covers much of the mailbox. It handles threads, messages and labels, sending including drafts.send, and filters that add or remove labels and forward mail. It also supports push notifications, signature standardization, delegation and migration, and developers say it replaced hacky IMAP code with simple HTTP calls. Several UI features appear only in help-center docs with no API counterpart in the evidence: snooze, undo send, offline outbox, and Gemini summarize/draft/organize. Nothing documents a full UI-to-API parity commitment. missing for 10: API evidence for snooze, undo send and Gemini features; an explicit UI/API parity statement; independent hands-on confirmation of parity
